svg.text: reference at its metric-oriented tuning (dashed: to its default)
Bars: interquartile range of per-clip BD. Every point is averaged over the same clips (see the table for excluded clips). Hollow: flagged.
NVENC (RTX 5090 GPU): aggregate encode throughput, 8 parallel streams, frames in GPU memory; GPU time, not CPU, and never on the Pareto front.
